name: Wyze Cam v4 (US)

radios.note: 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi only (802.11 b/g/n); no 5 GHz.

matter.note: Neither Wyze page mentions Matter, and no CSA listing was checked. Absence is not a no.

apple_home.note: Wyze's Cam v4 pages do not mention Apple Home or HomeKit. A Wyze article saying Wyze Cam is not compatible with HomeKit covers the original Wyze Cam, not this model.

google_home.note: Wyze lists Google Assistant as an integration. Its support page says a linked camera can be cast to a screen with "OK Google, show me (camera name)".

alexa.note: Works through the Wyze Alexa skill. Wyze's support page says "Alexa, show me [camera name]" shows the live view on a Fire TV, one stream at a time.

smartthings.note: Wyze's Cam v4 pages do not mention SmartThings.

home_assistant.note: No official Home Assistant or Wyze page confirming support for this model was found.

hubRequired.note: Wyze's setup steps have you pick your 2.4 GHz network in the app with the camera near the router; no hub or base station is mentioned. Live view needs internet.

localControl.note: Wyze says live view in its app needs an internet connection. No RTSP or local-only control is mentioned on the pages we saw.

cameraType.note: Wired camera rated for indoor and outdoor use (IP65). Outdoor use needs the separately sold Outdoor Power Adapter.

power.note: 6 ft USB cable with a 5 V / 1 A indoor adapter included.

localStorage.note: Records to a microSD card (sold separately). The spec page says up to 256 GB, exFAT; the product page FAQ mentions up to 512 GB.

subscription.value: Cloud recording and AI alerts (Cam Plus)
subscription.note: Wyze says cloud recording needs a plan; Cam Plus adds person, pet, package and vehicle detection and sound detection. Prices were not stated on the pages we saw.

summary: Wyze Cam v4 works with Alexa and Google Home through Wyze's own integrations, and needs no hub. It's a wired camera rated IP65 for indoor or outdoor use, and it records to a microSD card without a subscription. Cloud recording and AI detections need a Cam Plus plan. Wyze's pages don't mention Apple Home, SmartThings or Matter.
caveats: Outdoor use needs the Outdoor Power Adapter, sold separately.
Cloud recording and AI alerts need a Cam Plus subscription.
Wyze's pages disagree on the maximum microSD size (256 GB vs 512 GB).
